provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. rationale: The landing md/given-typing.md#claim-given.typing.take directly introduces taking a source place and updating its root environment entry. Relative place, source place expression, and environment description have direct links. The b.item.left intuition explains root/suffix decomposition before the equations. The accessibility premise links pos; the result and update cases link focusing and emptying. The new take operator and root-empty case are defined here. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
